input.name: vn-hn-quest-sample-v1
input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One small sealed specimen capsule for carrying a cultivation material sample. A short upright HEXAGONAL opaque pale-celadon ceramic cylinder, broad antique-brass cap and base rim, a single wide ivory paper seal fastened down its front under a small dark teal diamond clasp. The front seal has one plain geometric diamond, no calligraphy. One short ivory carrying loop at the cap. Intact state, no leakage or effects. Must be clearly different from a round glass water flask or a rectangular storage chest. Camera: orthographic high-angle three-quarter game view about 40 degrees downward, see top/front/right facets. Physical scale is hand-sized relative to a 64x96 native actor; later body 28x46 pixels in a 48x64 canvas. All forms readable also as a 32px inventory-style display, although this is an activity state prop. VAN NGOC approved visual direction described in text: decisive dark petrol outlines, clean three-tone cel shading, broad celadon jade and ivory stone planes, restrained aged brass details, warm light from upper left. Crisp illustrated 2D cultivation RPG prop, no photographic 3D rendering, airbrush, bloom, noisy microfiligree, labels, text, letters, watermark, characters, scenery or interface. Reference pixels are NOT transmitted by this tool. Plain solid #FF00FF chromakey background with no ground shadow or magenta reflected light. Isolated complete subject with at least 12 percent clear margin.
